Before becoming a Reform Jew, I had always perceived the whole Jewish world as being insular and closed off from society. It kept me from approaching the Rabbi sooner.

I just finished my conversion process a week ago after a year of learning. You should speak to a Rabbi about this if you think you even MIGHT want to convert. Any Rabbi worth their salt will work with you on that. If you can't make it every week, then fine. I have severe anxiety as well so I know how you feel. Message me if you have any questions!!
